modos.descricao: Escolher 1 Garou. Se aprovado, o Garou é revelado como Skindancer (Wyrm) e removido do jogo.

_metadata.texto_original: Choose 1 Garou. Successful vote means that the Garou is revealed as being a Skindancer (thus of the Wyrm and considered an enemy card) and is removed from his pack and placed in the Hunting Grounds.
